statements.status_notes: PostgreSQL fixed CVE-2026-6479 (PostgreSQL SSL/GSS init causes denial of service, via uncontrolled recursion) in 16.14 on the PostgreSQL 16 branch: https://www.postgresql.org/support/security/CVE-2026-6479/ lists 16.14 as the fixed release for major version 16 (versions before 16.14 are affected), and the 16.14 release notes, https://www.postgresql.org/docs/release/16.14/, list this CVE. The fix is commit https://github.com/postgres/postgres/commit/66cf26b9e4be1b46a5039bb7ea37f65d1e52e763 on the REL_16_STABLE branch, which changes src/backend/postmaster/postmaster.c so that ProcessStartupPacket() no longer recurses without bound on repeated SSL and GSS negotiation requests; it is tagged Security: CVE-2026-6479 and is in the REL_16_14 release tag and not in REL_16_13. The DHI postgresql16 packages for Alpine 3.23 are built from Alpine's postgresql16 APKBUILD, which builds the upstream PostgreSQL release tarball; the 16.14-r0 APKBUILD, https://github.com/alpinelinux/aports/blob/56de254843f841a99aedea4953a2dc9ec9338eb4/community/postgresql16/APKBUILD, differs from the 16.13-r0 one only in the version and tarball checksum, applies no patch that touches the files this fix changes, and lists CVE-2026-6479 under its 16.14-r0 secfixes. We checked the postgres server binary, /usr/libexec/postgresql16/postgres, in every postgresql16 build published for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI package repository as of 2026-11-27, on both x86_64 and aarch64 (package checksums verified against the package index): 16.13-r0 reports PostgreSQL 16.13 and is affected, while 16.14-r0, 16.15-r0 and 16.16-r0 report 16.14, 16.15 and 16.16 and carry the fix. This fix adds no distinctive message string, so the per-build evidence is the version each server binary reports. 16.14-r0 is the first published build that carries the fix.
